pages.quiz:
HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about National Security is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain National Security with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing National Security.
   C. Treat National Security as rumours only.
   D. Say National Security never happens in Kenya.

2. Which statement about Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya.
   B. Explain Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya as rumours only.
   D. Say Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya never happens in Kenya.

3. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Kisumu
   C. Mombasa
   D. Nakuru

4. Which statement about Civilisations in South and Central Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Civilisations in South and Central Africa as rumours only.
   B. Explain Civilisations in South and Central Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Civilisations in South and Central Africa.
   D. Say Civilisations in South and Central Africa never happens in Kenya.

5. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

6. Which statement about Kenyans Response to Colonialism is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Kenyans Response to Colonialism with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Kenyans Response to Colonialism never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Kenyans Response to Colonialism.
   D. Treat Kenyans Response to Colonialism as rumours only.

7. Which statement about Political developments in independent Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Political developments in independent Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Political developments in independent Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Political developments in independent Africa.
   D. Treat Political developments in independent Africa as rumours only.

8. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Hide all money underground
   D. Ignore prices in shops

9. Which statement about French Revolutions is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain French Revolutions with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing French Revolutions.
   C. Treat French Revolutions as rumours only.
   D. Say French Revolutions never happens in Kenya.

10. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Name the president

11. Which statement about Colonial Administration in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Colonial Administration in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Colonial Administration in Africa as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Colonial Administration in Africa.
   D. Explain Colonial Administration in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. Which statement about Human Developments in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Human Developments in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Human Developments in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Human Developments in Africa as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Human Developments in Africa.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Civilisations in South and Central Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Colonial Administration in Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Political developments in independent Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Internal conflicts in Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Civilisations in South and Central Africa; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Political developments in independent Africa; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Internal conflicts in Africa; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
